title: SelectedRouteSchema
description: Formal JSON Schema contract for Roads Selection API SelectedRoute resources in RMI (Roads Management Insights).

displayName.description: User-friendly display name (up to 100 Unicode code points).

dynamicRouting.description: Routing dynamism flag: true enables live-traffic path drift and dynamic rerouting across input waypoints; false (default) pins a fixed corridor computed via static un-congested traffic-unaware routing at creation time.

dynamicRoute.description: Geographical waypoint definitions (origin, destination, and up to 25 intermediates).

intermediates.description: Ordered sequence of authentic intermediate waypoints (maximum 25 waypoints).

routeAttributes.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata tags for downstream filtering and BigQuery analysis (max 25 pairs).

propertyNames.description: Attribute keys must be 1-100 characters and must NOT start with 'goog'.

additionalProperties.description: Attribute values must be non-empty strings between 1 and 100 characters.

state.description: Output-only lifecycle state of the route.

validationError.description: Output-only error code populated when state is STATE_INVALID.

createTime.description: Output-only timestamp when the route was created.

updateTime.description: Output-only timestamp when the route was last modified.
